verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local LLM inference engine, so GGUF support is a fair question for it, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions GGUF. Its documented model loading uses its own bundled repos (base checkpoint plus LoRA and prerouter adapters), with the tier auto-detected from a `config.json` via transformers-style AutoEngine, and none of this is a GGUF loader.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and run models packaged in the GGUF format
